The fifth volume of Wilson’s Vishnu Purāṇa, a system of Hindu mythology and tradition, edited by Fitzedward Hall, with his notes (London, 1877). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned and hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Vishnu Purana: A System Of Hindu Mythology And Tradition. Vol-V · H.H. Wilson (Tr.) · 1877, 273 scanned pages. Published 1877; H. H. Wilson died 1860 and Fitzedward Hall 1901; the text is ancient; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit.
